content:
maya: Heads-up — planning a Python/TS SDK publish in tomorrow's 8am-10am PT change window. Need final manifest, deprecation blurb for the sync client, and the release notes snippet. @kevin @jenna please confirm blockers.
kevin: SG. Quick question — are we still pinning the legacy sync client 1.x in the registry for one week? saw a flaky in staging related to the sync runtime.
jenna: running a quick smoke on the canary artifacts now. hit a checksum mismatch for linux wheel earlier, logs: ```pip install redwood-sdk==2.3.0rc1
ERROR: hash mismatch for redwood_sdk-2.3.0rc1-py3-none-any.whl
expected: sha256:abcd... got: 1234...```
sam: that was the sdist name mismatch from the build script, fixed in #435. rebuilding and re-uploading wheels to staging now.
deploy-bot: artifact-upload detected: redwood-sdk-2.3.0rc1.whl uploaded to staging (s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/2.3.0rc1), signature OK. Scheduled canary publish window -> 2026-03-22T15:00:00Z.
maya: Cool. QA: can you confirm pinning strategy? Plan: pin sync client 1.x for one week and include a migration example in release notes and a `compat` shim note. Also include deprecation date + link to migration guide.
jenna: will validate the rebuilt wheels and run regression suite, will report back by 12:30 PT. If green, I approve canary.
kevin: rollback criteria we'd like on record: any >2% error increase on core API smoke tests OR embedding perf regressions >1.5x token-cost. If either triggers, deploy-bot rollback <artifact> and revert docs publish.
sam: docs PR with migration snippet merged: `/docs/migrate-sync-client` — example code included: ```python
from redwood import Client
# new async-first usage
client = Client(api_key=..., sync=False)
await client.generate(...)
```
maya: Thanks — I'll draft the deprecation blurb and release notes (short, non-alarmist). tagging marketing for tone: @alex can you review?
alex: :thumbsup: paste the blurb here when ready, I'll trim for customer-facing language and avoid 'breaking' phrasing.
deploy-bot: Action queued: publish scheduled for canary. To abort: `deploy-bot cancel 1999991111` or run `deploy-bot rollback redwood-sdk-2.3.0rc1` if rollback criteria met.
